source.note: Curated subset of the atlas meshes (skeleton + superficial musculature) used as the animated teaching body: same meshes and measurements, X flipped into the character frame, bridging muscles carry two-bone weights.

encoding.positions: base64 float32 LE xyz metres, character frame (+X character left, +Y up, +Z forward)
encoding.weights: optional float32 per vertex: weight on `bone`, (1 - weight) on `boneB`
